chapter: Radio color line, San Francisco and Columbia staff
title: Black musicians absent from radio except guest stars
summary: Lee says he was the only black radio musician, apart from guests like Louis Armstrong with Bing Crosby.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Was it -- could you take a job for a single show in radio? Or was there just no black musicians in radio?
No, no, no. No black musicians at any time.
Oh no. I was the one.
With the exceptions of guest shots. I mean, celebrities could do guest shots.
We had Louis -- he used to do a lot of things with Bing and that type of thing, when they had -- what's the big show that Bing and them had with ...
